newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chip stocks modestly higher ahead of election.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chip stocks modestly higher ahead of election.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks posted modest gains Monday as Wall Street headed into Tuesday's national elections.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average ended up 19.75 points at 6,041.68, while the Nasdaq index lost 1.27 to 1,220.51. In the broader market, advancing issues led declines by a small margin on moderate volume of 393 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
